summary: Completed testing of RRHH Catálogos module (Puestos and Tipos de Incidencias). All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified: Catálogos tab visible, Puestos/Tipos de Incidencias sub-tabs working, Admin sees create/edit/delete buttons, Supervisor sees 'Solo lectura' message and no action buttons, Script SQL modal opens correctly with NomiPAQ/MPRO/Excel compatibility info.
critical_code_review_comments: Permission control correctly implemented - check_admin_role() function validates user role before CRUD operations
Frontend correctly checks isAdmin state to show/hide create buttons
API endpoints return 403 for non-admin users attempting to create/edit/delete
Script SQL modal shows comprehensive SQL for EDARSA HUB with NomiPAQ, MPRO, Excel compatibility
Tables may return empty if RH_Cat_Puestos/RH_Cat_Tipos_Incidencias don't exist in EDARSA HUB (expected behavior)
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tables may be empty if EDARSA HUB tables don't exist
context_for_next_testing_agent: RRHH Catálogos module fully tested. Key findings: 1) GET /api/rrhh/catalogos/puestos returns list (may be empty). 2) GET /api/rrhh/catalogos/tipos-incidencias returns list with default types if table doesn't exist. 3) GET /api/rrhh/catalogos/script-inicializacion returns SQL script. 4) POST endpoints require Administrador role (403 for others). 5) Frontend correctly shows/hides buttons based on user role. 6) Supervisor sees 'Solo lectura' message.
